name: Gaurav Tiwari: Black Friday Mac App Deals
accepts: The form names SaaS, WordPress products and developer tools, with a 20% or more discount guideline. The site also runs a Black Friday Mac App Deals page with an indie section, where an app for Mac, iPhone and iPad was listed; there is no iOS page.
cost_note: Free standard listing. Spotlight $100, Featured $200, Featured Lifetime $500 (20 Nov 2026).
entry_format: Fields: your name, email, product name, product URL, about the product (2 to 4 sentences), deal type, coupon (optional), the offer (usual price, deal price, currency, plan), offer dates (with year and time zone), banner (optional), affiliate program URL (optional), anything else, featured tier.
rules: The owner reviews each listing within 3 business days and sends the listing link if it is selected.
'For Black Friday, submit 2 to 3 weeks before the event.'
status_note: On 22 Nov 2026 the Mac app deals page said its indie section has 'the offers from this year's thread and from my inbox' (r/macapps and developers who 'send them to me directly'), with more than 40 indie apps listed.
recommended_for: Mac apps (its Mac app deals page); the form names SaaS, WordPress and developer tools
